title: RDL-Bench: A Benchmark for Task-Aware Question Answering over Relational Databases
abstract: arXiv:2610.21382v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Relational databases (RDBs) remain the primary infrastructure for storing and managing structured data across enterprise and scientific domains. Natural-language (NL) interfaces to RDBs aim to let users ask questions without writing SQL, but real user needs go beyond SQL-style lookup: some questions require reasoning over the observable database state, while others require predictive inference from historical relational records under temporal constraints. Existing benchmarks address these goals in isolation. To address this gap, we introduce RDL-Bench, a benchmark for task-aware question answering (QA) over real RDBs. RDL-Bench organizes diverse user questions into reasoning-oriented questions, whose answers are determined by the current database state, and prediction-oriented questions, whose answers depend on future outcomes under temporal constraints. translated_title: RDL-Bench：一个面向关系数据库的任务感知问答基准
translated_abstract: 关系数据库（RDBs）仍然是企业和科学领域中存储与管理结构化数据的主要基础设施。面向关系数据库的自然语言（NL）接口旨在让用户无需编写SQL即可提问，但真实的用户需求超越了SQL风格的查询：有些问题需要对可观察的数据库状态进行推理，而另一些问题则需要在时间约束下基于历史关系记录进行预测性推断。现有的基准测试将这些目标孤立地加以处理。为了填补这一空白，我们提出了RDL-Bench，这是一个针对真实关系数据库的任务感知问答（QA）基准。RDL-Bench将多样化的用户问题分为两类：推理导向型问题，其答案由当前数据库状态决定；预测导向型问题，其答案取决于时间约束下的未来结果。每个实例包含一个自然语言问题、任务元数据、模式信息、时间约束……
tldr: RDL-Bench是一个针对真实关系数据库的任务感知问答基准，它将用户问题分为由当前数据库状态决定的推理型问题和需要在时间约束下基于历史记录进行预测的预测型问题，填补了现有基准只孤立处理这些目标的空白。
en_tdlr: RDL-Bench is a task-aware QA benchmark over real relational databases that organizes user questions into reasoning-oriented ones (determined by the current database state) and prediction-oriented ones (requiring predictive inference under temporal constraints), addressing the gap left by existing benchmarks that tackle these goals in isolation.
